title: Payoff and Title Desk Schedule, Retail Installment Contracts: Statement Window by Account Standing
content:
The statement window — the days a Retail Installment Contracts payoff statement runs from its quote date — is set by the contract's standing on the quote date:

| Standing on the quote date | Statement window |
|---|---|
| past due (the next due date is earlier than the quote date) | **5** days |
| not past due, but a late charge was assessed on the contract, waived or not, in the rolling **6** months ending on the quote date | **7** days |
| every other contract | the product's payoff quote validity |

The rolling 6 months run from records dated later than the same calendar day 6 months before the quote date (the last day of that month when that day does not exist) through the quote date.

**Hypothetical readings (quote date 18 August).**

- Next due date 12 August: past due, 5 days, whatever the late-charge history.
- Next due date 18 August, a late charge dated 19 February, waived: not past due (the next due date is on the quote date), the charge is later than 18 February, so 7 days.
- Next due date 3 September, last late charge dated 18 February: that charge is not later than the 6-month mark, so the product's payoff quote validity applies.
